skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to develop applications and computer systems in real-world scenarios.
Analyze problems in the field of Computer Science, from requirement analysis to implementation.
Evaluate the effectiveness and feasibility of solutions, and propose and assess optimization methods to improve system performance and reliability.
Proficiency in applying skills to create effective solutions for practical problems in the field.
Collaborate and work effectively in teams to promote creativity and progress in solving complex problems.

Demonstrate communication and problem-solving abilities in a real-world environment through presentations and discussions of developed solutions, while receiving and evaluating feedback to enhance product quality and work processes.
Implement specific goal setting, planning actions, and executing necessary steps to achieve goals during the thesis project.
Take responsibility and make appropriate decisions at different stages of the project, including topic selection, data collection, result analysis, and report completion.
Complete and present reports professionally and effectively, demonstrating self-learning and self-management skills throughout the research and thesis project execution process.
